findings.evidence: openspec/specs/agentic-maintenance/spec.md:85 and :89 ('Neither triage nor periodic review SHALL create...', 'WHEN triage or weekly review identifies...'), :110 ('WHEN event-driven triage, scheduled backlog review ... have been validated'), :21 ('automated maintenance/triage functionality'). The delta (specs/agentic-maintenance/spec.md) neither modifies nor removes these.
findings.summary: The delta leaves accepted requirements that still describe event-driven triage as a live capability, so the post-archive spec will be partly inconsistent with the new 'Event-driven process triage is not installed' requirement.

findings.evidence: design.md decision 5 keeps the requirement. Spec lines 48-53 describe 'a labelled dev-platform process issue'. The test diff shows the remaining workflows use 'GITHUB_MCP_SERVER_TOKEN: ${{ steps.private_read_token.outputs.token }}', and the removed triage-only branch was the one asserting '"repos": "public"'.
findings.summary: 'Public pilot reads remain public-only' is kept as the constraint for any public-reading workflow, but its only scenario was the labelled process-issue read. The two remaining workflows read private Backlog issues, so the requirement now has no applicable workflow and could be read as contradicting them.
